slug: 2026-07-15 CSquared boosts internet by integrating with 2Africa West cable

facts.fact: Mobile Europe (15 Jul 2026) reports CSquared's existing architecture includes the Equiano system landing in Nigeria and Togo, reaching Benin, Ghana and Burkina Faso via terrestrial backbone.

note: 2Africa West is not stated to land in Togo, so no fact for it.
